body.message: I just want to say we are very disappointed that you guys did not fix the problem we asked you to, this hose was about to explode yet you send someone here to fix it and all they say is it will be fine. 2 days later it explodes, please send someone that will fix our shower asap. We have put a new shower head on because of the water but this hose is now not usable and we require this to be fixed asap.
